```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(knitr)
  library(terra)
  library(tidyr)
})

first_existing <- function(paths) {
  matches <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(matches)) matches[[1]] else NA_character_
}

csv_paths <- c(
  "Full Posterior" = first_existing(params$full_csv),
  "Latent Posterior" = first_existing(c(
    params$latent_csv,
    "Output_Data/Predicted_Estimates/Growth_Factor_Latent_Posterior.csv"
  ))
)

raster_paths <- c(
  "Full Posterior" = first_existing(params$full_raster),
  "Latent Posterior" = first_existing(params$latent_raster)
)

required_columns <- c(
  "hh_count_2026", "predicted_hh_count_2026",
  "hh_lower_2026", "hh_upper_2026"
)

prediction_tables <- lapply(names(csv_paths), function(model) {
  path <- csv_paths[[model]]
  if (is.na(path)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  data <- read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE)
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(data))
  if (length(missing_columns)) {
    stop("CSV is missing required columns: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
  }
  data$.model <- model
  data
})
names(prediction_tables) <- names(csv_paths)
prediction_tables <- Filter(Negate(is.null), prediction_tables)

rasters <- lapply(raster_paths, function(path) {
  if (is.na(path)) NULL else terra::rast(path)
})
names(rasters) <- names(raster_paths)
rasters <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rasters)

artifact_inventory <- tibble(
  Model = rep(names(csv_paths), each = 2),
  Artifact = rep(c("EA prediction CSV", "2026 estimate raster"), times = 2),
  Path = as.vector(rbind(csv_paths, raster_paths)),
  Available = !is.na(Path)
) %>%
  mutate(Path = if_else(Available, Path, "Not found"))
```

This report reads saved outputs from the two growth-factor scripts. It does not
refit the INLA models. Run `quarto render growth_factor_results_report.qmd` from
the repository root. The input paths can be changed with Quarto parameters.

Both scripts export EA-level CSVs, but `pop_path` lacks a trailing directory
separator and the filenames are transposed relative to the script names. The
default paths below follow the files each script currently writes, rather than
the misleading filename labels.

## Available Outputs

```{r}
kable(artifact_inventory, caption = "Result files discovered by the report")
```

## EA-Level Estimates

The following summaries use the saved EA prediction CSVs, when available. Totals
and error metrics are calculated over records with both observed and predicted
2026 household counts. Interval coverage is the share of those records whose
observed count falls between the saved lower and upper estimates.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Overall Validation

```{r}
if (length(prediction_tables)) {
  validation <- bind_rows(lapply(names(prediction_tables), function(model) {
    data <- prediction_tables[[model]]
    observed <- data$hh_count_2026
    predicted <- data$predicted_hh_count_2026
    valid <- complete.cases(observed, predicted)
    observed <- observed[valid]
    predicted <- predicted[valid]
    residual <- observed - predicted
    covered <- observed >= data$hh_lower_2026[valid] &
      observed <= data$hh_upper_2026[valid]
    correlation <- if (length(observed) > 1 && sd(observed) > 0 && sd(predicted) > 0) {
      cor(observed, predicted)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    tibble(
      Model = model,
      n = length(observed),
      Observed_total = sum(observed),
      Predicted_total = sum(predicted),
      Bias = mean(residual),
      Imprecision = sd(residual),
      MAE = mean(abs(residual)),
      MSE = mean(residual^2),
      RMSE = sqrt(mean(residual^2)),
      Correlation = correlation,
      Interval_coverage = if (any(!is.na(covered))) mean(covered, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
    )
  }))

  kable(validation, digits = 3, caption = "2026 validation against observed EA counts")
} else {
  cat("EA validation metrics are unavailable until an EA prediction CSV is present.")
}
```

### Household Summaries

```{r}
if (length(prediction_tables)) {
  ea_values <- bind_rows(prediction_tables) %>%
    select(.model, hh_count_2026, predicted_hh_count_2026) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(hh_count_2026, predicted_hh_count_2026),
      names_to = "Measure",
      values_to = "Households"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Measure = recode(
      Measure,
      hh_count_2026 = "Observed 2026",
      predicted_hh_count_2026 = "Predicted 2026"
    )) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Households)) %>%
    group_by(.model, Measure) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      Total = sum(Households),
      Mean = mean(Households),
      SD = sd(Households),
      Median = median(Households),
      Q1 = quantile(Households, 0.25),
      Q3 = quantile(Households, 0.75),
      Min = min(Households),
      Max = max(Households),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(Model = .model)

  kable(ea_values, digits = 2, caption = "EA-level household count summaries")
} else {
  cat("No EA prediction CSVs were found at the configured paths.")
}
```


### Rural/Urban Validation

```{r}
if (length(prediction_tables)) {
  by_stratum <- bind_rows(prediction_tables) %>%
    filter(!is.na(hh_count_2026), !is.na(predicted_hh_count_2026)) %>%
    mutate(
      residual = hh_count_2026 - predicted_hh_count_2026,
      covered = hh_count_2026 >= hh_lower_2026 & hh_count_2026 <= hh_upper_2026
    ) %>%
    group_by(.model, ADM_STATUS) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      Observed_total = sum(hh_count_2026),
      Predicted_total = sum(predicted_hh_count_2026),
      Bias = mean(residual),
      MAE = mean(abs(residual)),
      RMSE = sqrt(mean(residual^2)),
      Interval_coverage = if (any(!is.na(covered))) mean(covered, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(Model = .model, Stratum = ADM_STATUS)

  kable(by_stratum, digits = 3, caption = "2026 validation by rural/urban stratum")
}
```

:::

### Diagnostic Plots

These plots recreate the model scripts' EA diagnostics from the saved prediction
CSVs, without refitting either model. Vertical bars show the saved prediction
intervals; the dashed line marks equal observed and predicted counts.

```{r}
ea_plot_data <- bind_rows(prediction_tables)
if (nrow(ea_plot_data)) {
  ea_plot_data <- ea_plot_data %>%
    filter(is.finite(hh_count_2026), is.finite(predicted_hh_count_2026)) %>%
    rename(Model = .model)

  ea_distributions <- ea_plot_data %>%
    select(Model, hh_count_2026, predicted_hh_count_2026) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(hh_count_2026, predicted_hh_count_2026),
      names_to = "Measure",
      values_to = "Households"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Measure = recode(
      Measure,
      hh_count_2026 = "Observed 2026",
      predicted_hh_count_2026 = "Predicted 2026"
    ))
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Observed vs Predicted

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-cap: "Observed and predicted 2026 EA household counts with prediction intervals."
if (nrow(ea_plot_data)) {
  ggplot(ea_plot_data, aes(x = hh_count_2026, y = predicted_hh_count_2026)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#219ebc") +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = hh_lower_2026, ymax = hh_upper_2026),
      width = 0, alpha = 0.4, color = "#264653", na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(vars(Model), nrow = 1) +
    labs(x = "Observed households", y = "Predicted households") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
} else {
  cat("No complete EA predictions are available for plotting.")
}
```

#### Household Count Densities

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

if (nrow(ea_plot_data)) {
  density_data <- ea_distributions %>%
    group_by(Model, Measure) %>%
    filter(n() >= 2, n_distinct(Households) > 1) %>%

      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Observed 2026" = "#2a9d8f", "Predicted 2026" = "#e76f51")) +

      labs(x = "Household count", y = "Density", fill = NULL, color = NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  } else {
    cat("Density plots require at least two distinct household counts per group.")
  }
} else {
  cat("No complete EA predictions are available for plotting.")
}
```

## Raster Estimates

Raster totals sum the grid-cell household estimates. Quantiles below are
calculated from a regular sample of up to 100,000 raster cells; the other
statistics use all non-missing cells.

```{r}
if (length(rasters)) {
  raster_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(rasters), function(model) {
    raster <- rasters[[model]]
    stats <- terra::global(raster, c("min", "max", "mean", "sum", "sd"), na.rm = TRUE)
    valid_cells <- terra::global(!is.na(raster), "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
    sample_size <- min(100000, terra::ncell(raster))
    sample_values <- terra::spatSample(
      raster,
      size = sample_size,
      method = "regular",
      na.rm = TRUE,
      as.df = TRUE
    )[[1]]
    quantiles <- quantile(sample_values, c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)

    tibble(
      Model = model,
      Rows = terra::nrow(raster),
      Columns = terra::ncol(raster),
      Valid_cells = as.numeric(valid_cells),
      No_data_cells = terra::ncell(raster) - as.numeric(valid_cells),
      Total = as.numeric(stats[1, "sum"]),
      Mean = as.numeric(stats[1, "mean"]),
      SD = as.numeric(stats[1, "sd"]),
      Min = as.numeric(stats[1, "min"]),
      Q1_sampled = as.numeric(quantiles[[1]]),
      Median_sampled = as.numeric(quantiles[[2]]),
      Q3_sampled = as.numeric(quantiles[[3]]),
      Max = as.numeric(stats[1, "max"]),
      Cell_width = terra::res(raster)[1],
      Cell_height = terra::res(raster)[2],
      CRS = terra::crs(raster)
    )
  }))

  kable(raster_summary, digits = 3, caption = "2026 raster summary statistics")
} else {
  cat("No 2026 estimate rasters were found at the configured paths.")
}
```

```{r}
has_both_rasters <- all(c("Full Posterior", "Latent Posterior") %in% names(rasters))
same_geometry <- has_both_rasters && terra::compareGeom(
  rasters[["Full Posterior"]],
  rasters[["Latent Posterior"]],
  stopOnError = FALSE
)

if (same_geometry) {
  difference <- rasters[["Full Posterior"]] - rasters[["Latent Posterior"]]
  difference_stats <- terra::global(difference, c("min", "max", "mean", "sum", "sd"), na.rm = TRUE)
  kable(
    tibble(
      Statistic = c("Minimum", "Maximum", "Mean", "Sum", "SD"),
      Full_minus_Latent = unlist(
        difference_stats[1, c("min", "max", "mean", "sum", "sd")],
        use.names = FALSE
      )
    ),
    digits = 3,
    caption = "Pixel-wise difference (full posterior minus latent posterior)"
  )
} else if (has_both_rasters) {
  cat("Raster grids differ, so a cell-by-cell difference was not calculated.")
}
```

```{r}
if (length(rasters)) {
  raster_samples <- bind_rows(lapply(names(rasters), function(model) {
    values <- terra::spatSample(
      rasters[[model]],
      size = min(60000, terra::ncell(rasters[[model]])),
      method = "regular",
      na.rm = TRUE,
      as.df = TRUE,
      xy = TRUE
    )
    names(values)[1:2] <- c("x", "y")
    names(values)[3] <- "Estimate"
    mutate(values, Model = model)
  }))

  ggplot(raster_samples, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = Estimate)) +
    geom_raster() +
    coord_equal() +
    facet_wrap(vars(Model)) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "sqrt", name = "Households") +
    labs(title = "2026 gridded household estimates", x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

```{r}
if (length(rasters)) {
  ggplot(raster_samples, aes(x = Estimate, fill = Model, color = Model)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.2) +
    labs(
      title = "Distribution of 2026 grid-cell estimates",
      x = "Estimated households per cell",
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

## Interpretation Notes

- The latent-posterior script samples the latent growth factor; the full-posterior script also includes lognormal observation-level variation. Their intervals and raster distributions therefore need not match.
- EA validation metrics are reported only when the corresponding CSV exists. The script-to-file mapping follows the current `write.csv` calls, not the transposed filenames.
- Raster quantiles are sampled to keep rendering practical. Raster totals and the other raster statistics are computed over all valid cells.
- Grid-cell estimates are allocated using the building-covariate weights in the scripts. Their sum should reproduce the associated EA-level predictions, subject to rasterization and missing-cell behavior.
